unstuck_said.text: Filed feature-request issue #2 on loootai/looot-mcp (https://github.com/loootai/looot-mcp/issues/2): proposed a Nano (XNO) settlement option beside the Stripe top-up rail. Named where it goes (top_up tool on api.looot.ai/mcp + a public-node block_info verifier), why it fits (gateway already quotes price before each run, charges only completed calls), and offered to write the top-up verifier as a PR. Framed in looot own terms as a settlement option, not a mission; no AI-work announcement. First contact with this operator.
